The approved volunteer mobile RSVP form is https://example.invalid/volunteer/rsvp. It works on a phone. Whether it is required or optional follows the latest applicable user decision.
The coordinator must print one attendance roster for internal check-in. This is operator paperwork, separate from participant registration.

Earlier user feedback from workshop work: From now on, across my projects, participant-facing instructions must work on a phone and must not require printing. This remains my default until I change it. It does not apply to internal operator paperwork.

decision.value: Phone-friendly participant instructions; no required printing.
